_about.title: Chromepet placement map -- single source of truth for asset positions
_about.frame: ENU metres relative to the origin. position_enu = [east_m, north_m]. glTF (x, y, z) = (east, up, -north). Unity (x, y, z) = (east, up, north).
_about.enu_to_lat_lon: lat = origin_lat + degrees(north_m / 6378137); lon = origin_lon + degrees(east_m / (6378137 * cos(origin_lat))). lat_lon in each entry is computed with this formula.
_about.heading_convention: heading_deg = compass bearing (clockwise from north, 0-360) of the asset's local +Y axis (its generator-frame north) after placement. The ENU yaw applied when baking is yaw_deg = (-heading_deg) mod 360, CCW from east. For builder-placed assets the Unity rotation Y equals heading_deg mod 360 mapped to (-180, 180] (e.g. heading 303.71 -> rotation Y -56.29), because in the Unity frame a positive Y rotation turns the front (+Z, north) toward +X (east), i.e. it increases the bearing.
_about.footprint_convention: footprint_m = [width along local X, depth along local Y] in the asset's local frame (before heading rotation); height_m is the world up extent. For world-baked layers and unrotated anchors this equals the world AABB extent. production_technology_frontage's position is its builder anchor, not its centroid (see its notes).
_about.source_values: osm = OpenStreetMap geometry (data/osm_raw.osm, ODbL) | v2_meta = data/v2_meta.json / identity_meta.json anchors from the v2 build | roads_geometry = measured from roads/roads_v2.glb + campus_buildings.glb geometry | photo_relative = placed relative to neighbours from the user's campus photos (REFERENCE_VIDEOS.md)
_about.confidence_values: high = surveyed/recorded anchor or measured from shipped geometry | approximate = geometry-derived placement, not surveyed; expect metre-level error
_about.status_values: sited = placed by the 2026-10-21 siting pass | existing_anchor = placed by earlier work and recorded here
_about.generated_from: tools/mit_details.py logic + data/v2_meta.json + data/osm_raw.osm (OSM) + measured GLB bounds; assets sited by tools/oat_theatre.py, tools/avenue_garden_landmarks.py, tools/production_technology_frontage.py, tools/navy_aircraft.py, tools/connector_paths.py. Visual map: tools/placement_map_image.py reads this file only.

assets.name: Ground layer (campus + outside ground, avenue paving)
assets.notes: World-baked v2 layer spanning the full OSM bbox; campus ground polygon per tools/mit_details.py.

assets.name: Roads layer (GST Road, MIT Flyover, railway, station, campus roads)
assets.notes: World-baked v2 layer. Campus road centrelines are listed in road_network.

assets.name: Campus buildings layer (60 procedural MIT buildings)
assets.notes: World-baked; footprint/height are the layer's world AABB. Includes the Production Technology node box and Admin Block (separate anchor entries).

assets.name: Outside buildings layer (8,732 surrounding buildings)
assets.notes: World-baked v2 layer spanning the full OSM bbox; footprint is the nominal bbox extent.

assets.name: Landmarks layer (gate, fountain, tank, walkway, grove aircraft, spawn markers)
assets.notes: World-baked; individual anchors (Main Gate, Rajam statue arch, fountain, aircraft grove) have their own entries.

assets.name: Trees layer (2,510 trees)
assets.notes: World-baked; trunk colliders in props/trees_colliders.json. Trees are procedural filler and were not treated as siting obstacles.

assets.name: Chrompet identity layer (station boards, office, EMU, auto-rickshaws)
assets.notes: World-baked; position is the suburban EMU centre from data/identity_meta.json (rail yaw 73.5 deg ENU); footprint spans the layer's station-area features.

assets.name: Main Gate (MIT South Gate)
assets.notes: Node group 'Main_Gate' inside landmarks.glb at OSM node 432468247. heading_deg is the avenue bearing at the gate from data/v2_meta.json; the structure spans the avenue, local +Y taken along the avenue. Player spawn is 12 m inside the gate at ENU (-70.91, -253.28).

assets.name: Admin Block & Dean Office (procedural)
assets.notes: Node group in campus_buildings.glb; OSM node 5964208543, no-footprint procedural box measured in the GLB (x 11.3-39.3, north -83.3 to -65.3).

assets.name: Charles Babbage Block (detailed)
assets.notes: World-baked detailed replacement; position/footprint describe the main block (matching the 'Charles_Babbage_Block' node measured in campus_buildings.glb: x 228.0-270.9, north 152.3-184.1). The detailed GLB's full bounds span 101.0 x 152.5 m because it also carries forecourt/road context geometry. Scene builder hides the procedural node.

assets.name: Rajam statue arch + pool (landmarks layer)
assets.notes: Node group 'Rajam_statue' inside landmarks.glb at OSM node 582775241; heading approximate from mit_details.facing(). The detailed golden statue garden stands 7.6 m north-east (separate entry).

assets.name: Avenue fountain + Anna University sign
assets.notes: From data/v2_meta.json (fountain_enu); on the west side of the avenue, ~110 m inside the Main Gate.

assets.name: Aircraft display grove (Sea Hawk, Gnat, jet engines)
assets.notes: From data/v2_meta.json (aircraft_grove_enu); crude aircraft in landmarks.glb beside the Aero department. The detailed Navy display is a separate entry.

assets.name: Open Air Theatre (OAT)
assets.notes: World-baked (site in the GLB). West of the main avenue; terraces north/east/west, entrance + sign south. Site chosen as the only clear 63 m circle on campus ground between the avenue and the west service road; no OSM node exists for the OAT.

assets.name: MIT letters monument
assets.notes: World-baked. Avenue lawn inside the Main Gate, east side; long axis aligned to the avenue direction at the gate (yaw 55.73 deg ENU). Split out of the former avenue_garden_landmarks.glb on 2026-10-21.

assets.name: Golden statue garden (C. Rajam)
assets.notes: World-baked. 7.6 m north-east of the OSM Rajam Statue node, offset to clear Rajam Hall and the Rajam Hall Road bend; front (local -Y: benches/emblem side) faces the road bend. Paved spur leaves the pad toward the road. Does not replace rajam_statue_arch.

assets.name: Garden pergola
assets.notes: World-baked. Admin Block lawn garden (photo 18.jpg), west of the Admin Block, east of the west service road.

assets.name: Garden gazebo
assets.notes: World-baked. Same Admin-side garden as the pergola, ~27 m north-west of it (photo 18.jpg).

assets.name: Department of Production Technology frontage (detailed)
assets.notes: Origin-centred GLB; position_enu is the BUILDER ANCHOR (facade centre on the back-wall plane), not the footprint centroid. ChrompetSceneBuilder.Placements: position (170.42, 0, 75.39), rotation Y -56.29 deg. Additive overlay in front of the procedural node box (OSM node 432468201, ENU (184.2, 66.2)); the procedural building is NOT hidden.

assets.name: Indian Navy aircraft display
assets.notes: World-baked; position (aircraft centre) kept from the original siting -- roads geometry confirmed it is road-adjacent. heading_deg is the bearing of the local +Y (port side); nose bearing is 58.5 deg (yaw 0.55 rad ENU). Apron + path pad to the grove centre added 2026-10-21; footprint includes the pad.
